stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2024): 1,917 applicants and a 51% admit rate (31% of admitted students enrolled). The admits figure is derived (51% x 1,917, rounded), because IPEDS publishes only the percentage. Enrolled count, residency splits, international applicant/admit numbers and GPA are not published: no Common Data Set newer than 2016-17 is posted on lsus.edu. Undergraduate enrollment is the fall 2024 IPEDS figure; the student-faculty ratio of 30 to 1 is as printed by College Navigator (year not stated). SAT percentiles rest on only 15 submitting students; 247 submitted ACT. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.
